case: PostgreSQL bytea[] text binding across bytea_output settings
contract: A raw bytea[]::text projection under bytea_output=escape contains octal escapes for binary bytes 0x00 and 0xff.
The fixture includes binary bytes 00ff275c, an empty bytea element, and SQL NULL; native type, per-element hex, and array_send bytes are the independent oracles.
The escaped array text rebinds as bytea[] under escape output and still rebinds to identical native array bytes after switching the session to hex output.
